subject: Request: Commercial exemption for Solstice Health — Dedicated + Private bundle
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Commercial exemption for Solstice Health — Dedicated + Private bundle

Team,

Summary (short): Solstice Health (large regional provider) has verbally committed to a 3-year, multi-region deployment that combines Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Redwood Private (VPC, on-prem connector). They want a single bundled price and are asking for deeper-than-standard discounts plus waiver of the one-time onboarding fee and Net-60 payment terms. ACV asked-for geometry: list ~ $1,140,000/yr pre-discount; they requested 40% off list and a $50k onboarding waiver; total ask reduces year-1 to ~$684k.

Why this matters: reference potential (enterprise in our target vertical), strategic long-term deployment (3-year, multi-region), possible co-marketing ask, and customer is willing to sign a joint press release. They will also commit to an engineering pilot that proofs Private deploy (low integration risk).

What I need: VP / CFO-level signoff for a commercial exemption to approve:
- 40% list discount on the bundled SKU (requested) OR our counter (below)
- Waive $50k onboarding fee
- Net-60 payment terms (preferred by customer)
- Approval to include a 15% performance credit if SLA < SLO in year 1

Recommended counter (AE preference):
- Approve 35% discount year-1, 30% year-2, 25% year-3 (escalator back to list on renewal)
- Onboarding fee: reduce to $15k (not fully waived)
- Payment terms: Net-30 with 6% prepay discount for annual prepayment; if Net-60 required, take a 20% escrow clause / security deposit to mitigate cash risk

Attached: draft exception memo for VP/CFO, current pricing model, and draft T&Cs.

If you want, I can prep a one-page margin impact and comps doc for Marissa. Time is tight — Maria (procurement) wants a written position by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: solstice_exception_memo_v1.pdf (memo), redwood_terms_2026.docx (T&Cs)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Commercial exemption for Solstice Health — Dedicated + Private bundle

Jonas — thanks for the write-up. A few items I need before I can sign off or take to exec: 
- Straight margin impact by year (COGS estimate + gross margin) — Laura, can you run this?
- Are there comparable comps (other healthcare deals, same footprint) to justify the 35–40% band? Please include examples and outcomes.
- What is the sensitivity to onboarding fee? If we keep onboarding at $15k, will it materially affect likelihood-to-close?

I don't love Net-60 without an escrow or prepay; we should surface alternatives to procurement that get them to Net-30 or annual prepay. If this is a strategic reference account and marketing value is real, I can advocate for an additional concession, but need the margin math.

Also tag any regulatory or data residency constraints for Private deploy (this could increase COE). Marcus — ping for any operational constraints on Private + Dedicated hybrid in Q1-Q2 region.

- Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Commercial exemption for Solstice Health — Dedicated + Private bundle

Quick finance take (high level) — I ran the attached pricing_model_solstice.xlsx with conservative load assumptions for Private (engineering + infra amortized) and Dedicated GPU hours. Key points: 
- Estimated blended COGS: ~$310k in year-1 (includes infra, monitoring, priority support, on-call engineering pro rata) against list ACV $1,140,000 -> gross margin ~73% pre-discount.
- With AE's proposed counter (35% Y1), blended gross margin drops to ~46% in year-1. Over 3 years (with step-down discounts) LTV looks fine, but cash flow is a concern if we accept Net-60.
- If customer prepays annually we preserve positive cash flow; if Net-60, require security deposit equal to 1/3 of year-1 invoice or a letter of credit.
- Onboarding waiver: moving to $15k keeps implementation team prioritized and preserves ~$35k of initial coverage we need; full waiver hurts margin and means we absorb professional services cost.

Recommendation to Marissa: Approve up to 35% discount in year-1 only if either (a) annual prepay, or (b) escrow/letter-of-credit for Net-60. Otherwise cap at 30% with $15k onboarding fee. Also require quarterly business reviews with cost remediation clause for unexpected usage.

I attached the model and a short one-page margin summary. If you want, I can convert this into a CFO memo for formal sign-off.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_model_solstice.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@solsticehealth.com>, Diego Torres <diego.torres@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@solsticehealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solstice Health commercial terms (proposal)

Maria / Diego — thanks for the call yesterday and for outlining your priorities. Internal stakeholders have reviewed and we've put together a counter-proposal we can move forward with if Solstice is comfortable: 

Redwood counter (subject to final CFO sign-off):
- Year 1: 35% discount off list on bundled Dedicated + Private bundle
- Year 2: 30% discount; Year 3: 25% discount
- Onboarding fee: $15,000 (reduced from $50k)
- Payment: Net-30 standard; if Solstice requires Net-60, we can accept with a security deposit equal to 33% of year-1 invoice OR annual prepayment with 6% prepay discount
- SLA: standard 99.9% with a 15% performance credit if SLA missed in Year 1 (cap $50k)
- Fungible items: joint press release and a 12-month customer success reference commitment upon GA of Private deploy

Next steps: If this is acceptable, we'll prepare an exception memo for CFO sign-off (Laura will finalize margin appendix) and circulating signature-ready docs. Please let me know if you need contract language for escrow or prepayment options.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
